div.h2: Everything a heavy Flow user actually needs
div.p: Not a wrapper around one account — a full production desk for people who generate videos every single day.

article.p: Add as many accounts as you like — there is no cap. Every account brings its own daily free credits, so 100 accounts means 100× the credits. FlowStudio rotates between them automatically, so one account running dry never stops your batch.
Paste all your scene prompts in one go. Every prompt becomes a task, matched to its own Flow project and tile — nothing gets mixed up.
Give the batch to the built-in agent. It proposes generations with a clear credit quote — and a strict guard approves only quotes at or below the expected cost.
Finished videos save themselves into your Downloads folder, enhanced one step up where possible — verified by content, never by filename guesswork.

Prompts are divided by real credit capacity before anything starts — about 7 credits per video, up to 7 videos per account — so a run never dies halfway. And because accounts are unlimited, your total capacity grows every time you add one.
A download that stalls doesn't vanish. It stays parked and visible — restart one, restart all, or clear the list whenever you are ready.

div.h2: Learn it in one sitting
div.p: Seven short guides with the real steps — open any guide and follow along in the app.

ol.li: Press the Download button on this page and save FlowStudio_Setup.exe (about 74 MB).
Open the file from your Downloads folder and follow the installer — it takes under a minute.
If Windows shows a safety prompt, choose “More info” and then “Run anyway” — the setup is the official one from this page.
FlowStudio opens on its animated splash, then shows the sign-in portal over the blurred studio.
Create your account in the portal — your name, email and a password (or continue with Google).
Your key arrives by email. With Google sign-in, your mail opens for you so the key is right there.
Copy the key (it looks like FS-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX), paste it into the portal and press Activate.
The blur lifts and the studio unlocks. Without a valid key the app stays locked — nothing inside can be used.
One key works on one PC. If you change or format your PC, message support on WhatsApp for a reset.
Open the Accounts area and press Add account.
Sign in with that Google account once — FlowStudio keeps it ready for generation.
Repeat for every account you want — there is no limit. Add as many as you like: every account adds its own daily free credits, so 100 accounts means 100× the credits of one.
Credits are checked automatically, so you always see which accounts are ready and which are dry.
Write one clear prompt: subject, place, action and mood in a single line.
Pick the model (Omni Flash at 7 credits is the friendly default) and press Generate.
Watch the tile fill up — the progress line only runs on the video that is actually generating.
When it finishes, the video saves itself into your Downloads folder. Press play and check it.
Paste all your scene prompts at once — one prompt per line, the whole batch in a single run.
The planner divides the batch by credit capacity first: about 7 credits per video, up to 7 videos per account.
A browser only opens for an account that actually has work — no idle windows.
Accounts generate in parallel and every finished video is matched to its own prompt and saved.
Open Agent Mode and describe the batch you want in one message.
The agent proposes the generations with one combined credit quote.
The guard checks the quote against the expected cost for your model — at or below, it proceeds; above, it is rejected.
If a scene needs a fix, the repair happens in the same conversation and comes back as a fresh proposal.
Finished videos save into your Downloads folder, enhanced one step up where possible (for example 360p to 720p).
Every file is verified by its content — never trust the filename order alone.
If a download stalls, it stays parked and visible in the app instead of disappearing.
Restart one parked download, restart all of them, or clear the list whenever you are ready.

div.h2: Questions, answered straight
div.p: The things people ask before their first batch — answered without fine print.
Yes — the first 7 days are completely free with every feature unlocked, and no card is needed. After the trial you can continue with the Limited plan (₹99 / $1) or the Full 1 Year plan (₹499 / $5).

div.button: How many accounts can I add?

div.p: As many as you like — there is no cap. Every Google account you add brings its own daily free credits, so your total grows with your pool: 100 accounts means roughly 100× the credits of a single account. The credit planner divides your prompts across them — roughly 7 credits per video, up to about 7 videos per account per run — so no single account carries the whole batch.

div.button: Which models and credits does it use?

div.p: It works with the models available in Google Flow, including Omni and Veo. Agent Mode always shows the credit quote before anything runs, and its guard only approves quotes at or below the expected cost for the model you picked.

div.button: Is my key tied to one PC?

div.p: Yes. Your key activates on one computer and the app won't open without it — the studio stays locked until a valid key is entered. Changed or formatted your PC? Contact support on WhatsApp and the binding can be reset for you.
Straight into your Downloads folder — the same place every time, verified file by file. If a download ever stalls, it stays parked in the app instead of disappearing, ready to restart when you are.

div.h2: Plain words, no fine-print tricks

div.p: Your Google accounts sign in on your own PC and stay there. FlowStudio does not upload your account passwords anywhere, and your prompts and videos are yours — they are generated on your accounts and saved on your computer. We never sell your data. The only things the service itself handles are your sign-up name and email, and the key issued to you, so activation and support can work.

One key activates on one PC; sharing a key does not extend it, and a key can be reset for a genuine PC change through support. The free trial runs 7 days with full features. Paid plans apply only when they open — until then the app is free. You are responsible for the videos you create and for using your own accounts within the video service's own rules.
